chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Al-Fadl ibn Shazan, all from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurara, who said:

I was sitting beside Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), and he was sitting with his arms around his knees, facing the Ka'bah. He said: 'Indeed, looking at it is an act of worship.' Then a man from Bajilah came to him, called Asim ibn Umar, and said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): 'Ka'b al-Ahbar used to say that the Ka'bah prostrates to Bayt al-Maqdis every morning.' Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'So what do you say about what Ka'b said?' He said: 'He spoke the truth; the statement is what Ka'b said.' Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'You lied, and Ka'b al-Ahbar lied with you,' and he was angered.

Zurara said: 'I did not see him face anyone else by saying 'You lied' except him.' Then he said: 'Allah, Mighty and Majestic, did not create a spot on the earth more beloved to Him than it.' Then he gestured with his hand towards the Ka'bah, and said: 'Nor is anything more prestigious to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, than it. For it, Allah sanctified the sacred months in His Book the day He created the heavens and the earth: three consecutive ones for the Hajj — Shawwal, Dhu al-Qadah, and Dhu al-Hijjah — and a separate month for the Umrah, which is Rajab.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on looking at the Ka'bah and what is its status in Islam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) refutes the anthropomorphic view of Ka'bah prostrating to Jerusalem, affirming its unique status as the most beloved spot on earth to Allah. The narration further elucidates the divine institution of the four sacred months, distinguishing the three consecutive months for Hajj from the solitary month of Rajab designated for Umrah.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazan, altogether from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Umar Bin Azina, from Zurara who said,

‘I was seated by the side of Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> and he<sup>asws</sup> was Mohtab (Sitting with arms around the knees covered) facing the Kabah. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But, looking at the Kabah is (an act of) worship’. So a man from Bajeela called Aasim Bin Umar came over, so he said to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Ka’ab Al-Ahbaar was saying that the Kabah prostrates to Bayt Al-Maqdis during every morning’. So Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So what are you saying regarding what Ka’ab said?’ So he said, ‘He spoke the truth. The word (going around) is what Ka’ab said’. So Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘You lied, and Ka’ab Al-Ahbar lied along with you’, and (the Imam<sup>asws</sup>) was angered.

Zurara said, ‘I have not seen him<sup>asws</sup> facing anyone by saying: ‘You lied!’ apart from him. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic has not Created a spot in the earth more Beloved to Him<sup>azwj</sup>, than it’. Then he<sup>asws</sup> gestured with his<sup>asws</sup> hand towards the Kabah, (and said): ‘Nor is anything more Prestigious to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic than it. For it, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Sanctified the months in His<sup>azwj</sup> Book the day He<sup>azwj</sup> Created the skies and the earth. Three are consecutive for the Hajj – Shawwal, and Zul Qadah, and Zul Hijja, and a month separate for the Umra, and it is Rajab’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father and Muhammad ibn Isma‘il from af-Fadf ibn Shadhan all from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ‘Umar ibn ‘Udhaynah from Zurarah who has said the following:

“I, once, was sitting near abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, while he was sitting in an Ihtiba’ position (holding one’s knees against one’s belly with one’s arms or a piece of cloth) facing al-Ka’bah. He (the Imam) said, ’Looking at al-Ka’bah is an act of worship.’ At this time a man from Bajilah people who was called ‘Asem ibn ’Umar came to abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and said, ’Ka’b al-Ahbar would say, “Al-Ka‘bah every morning prostrates before al-Bayt al-Maqdis (the holy house in Jerusalem).”’ Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, then asked, ‘What do you say about what Ka’b has said?’ He (the man) replied, ’He has spoken the truth, the word is what Ka’b has said.’ Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, then said, ‘You have spoken lies. Ka’b al-Ahbar has spoken lies along with you.’ He (the Imam) became angry.

Zurarah has said, ‘I never found him (the Imam) facing someone say, “You speak lies” except him (this man).’ He (the Imam) then said, ‘Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, has not created any site on earth more beloved to Him than al-Ka‘bah.’ He (the Imam) then pointed with his hand to al-Ka’bah and said, ’There is not anything more graceful before Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, than al-Ka’bah. For this (al-Ka’bah) Allah made the sacred months, in His book, on the day He created the skies and earth. Of these months, three are consecutive: the months of Shawwal, Dhu al-Qa’dah and Dhu al-Hajjah, and one is alone for performing ‘Umrah (and it is) the month of Rajab.’”
